messages:
Lucas: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need concrete runbook/playbook edits and a tracked action list for the cache thrash incident. Short, actionable items please.

Jamie: Agreed. Observed gaps: ambiguous escalation path after prefix-level cache blowout, no quick triage commands in runbook, and no documented fallback model variant.

Maya: Suggested edits: 1) explicit escalation timeline (0m ack oncall, 5m notify eng-oncall channel, 15m page eng-lead), 2) add a concise triage checklist with exact commands, 3) document rolling to quantized model as fallback with perf notes.

Raj: For triage checklist include these snippets and expected outputs:
```bash
# pod logs (tail latest 200 lines)
POD=$(kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl -n inference logs $POD | tail -n 200

# redis memory snapshot
redis-cli -h redis.svc.cluster.local INFO memory | egrep "used_memory_human|maxmemory"
```
Put under "Initial Triage" with a small explanation of what to look for (OOMs, eviction counts).

Anna: We should add recurrence signals so SREs can flag regressions earlier. Proposal: cache_evictions_per_min > 100 for 5m OR 3 consecutive 95th latency spikes for same user cohort -> create regression ticket. I can draft thresholds.

Lucas: Assign owners: Jamie = escalation timeline + gating steps, Maya = triage checklist + commands, Raj = fallback model + routing instructions, Anna = recurrence thresholds and telemetry query. Deadline one week.

Jamie: I'll own the escalation matrix. Draft PR by 2026-04-08 EOD. Will include rationale and a toy timeline.

Maya: I'll add the triage section and include the commands + sample outputs. PR draft by 2026-04-10.

Raj: I'll document the fallback model id (redwood/quant-xx) and how to force-route: add route policy snippet and expected perf delta (~+20% latency, -40% cost). PR by 2026-04-11.

Anna: Drafting recurrence detection query and suggested thresholds. I'll add a short playbook snippet on when to escalate to remodel/retry. PR by 2026-04-12.

Ellie: Small ops note — add safe cache flush snippet and gating confirmation:```bash
# safe flush (prefix only)
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/flush-prefix -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"prefix":"session-xyz"}'
# require oncall-lead confirm before running
```
Include a warning about global flush side effects.

Lucas: Good. Also add verification checks post-fix: query metrics api and confirm miss rate drop and latency stabilization. Example: `curl https://metrics.internal/api?query=rate(cache_miss_total[5m])` and expect >50% drop within 10m.

Maya: Will include verification step and exact metric queries + thresholds.

Jamie: I'll add an explicit "who to page" list for each time boundary and a short script to message eng-oncall via Slack webhook.

karen-bot: Task created: TASK-4621 "Playbook edits: escalation, triage, fallback, recurrence" assigned to jamie, maya, raj, anna. Due 2026-04-12.

Lucas: Let's do a 15m follow-up check one week after due dates to verify PRs are merged and playbook staged. I'll schedule.

Raj: Noting pattern from last 4 incidents: small bursts -> KV growth over 3-6 minutes. I'll add telemetry link and quick detection query to playbook so oncall can spot pattern quickly.

Anna: If anyone wants me to sanity-check wording or thresholds ping me.

Lucas: Summary of owners/dates: jamie (escalation) 2026-04-08, maya (triage) 2026-04-10, raj (fallback) 2026-04-11, anna (recurrence) 2026-04-12. Follow-up meeting scheduled after 2026-04-12. :white_check_mark:

Maya: PRs: GH:infra/playbooks#882 (triage) draft.

Jamie: PR: GH:infra/playbooks#883 (escalation) draft.

karen-bot: Reminder scheduled: playbook review meeting 2026-04-14 15:00 UTC.

Lucas: Thanks everyone, keeping the action tracker updated. Ping here when PRs are ready for merge.
